source: Actual ActivityCostPanel rendered from the existing synthetic backend fixture plus declared cache-partition variants; existing built product CSS; no live API

variants.partial-cache: Known usage row: 1000 inclusive input, 10 output, 600 cache read, 100 cache write, cache detail for 800 input. Global/project/session usage fields use the same partitions.
variants.zero-cache: Same 1000 input/10 output, recorded zero cache read/write with full detail coverage.
variants.no-cache-detail: Unmodified backend fixture: 1000 input/10 output, zero covered input; cache split unavailable. Missing-usage rows stay unavailable.

theme: Existing explicit dark theme, no Dark Reader
interactions: Second session disclosure opened by click; Enter closed and reopened it
Tab reached its session link with visible amber outline
limits: Synthetic standalone component evidence, not deployed route/navigation/hydration
Known zero-input case covered by focused component assertion, not this browser variant
Prior rendered.json/screenshots remain evidence of the initial checkpoint; these artifacts cover the partition correction
